summary: The solution correctly identifies the task as regression and implements a thorough feature engineering pipeline alongside a LightGBM model. However, it suffers from critical temporal leakage: it creates lead features using future data, computes rolling statistics across the train-test boundary by concatenating them, and evaluates using a randomized K-Fold split instead of a time-based split. These issues introduce severe look-ahead bias, rendering the cross-validation scores highly unreliable.
